Lady on the phone was rude and refused to help out. It’s ridiculous that they want you to pay before you buy and won’t show you the part or tell you the color. I was trying to buy a bumper but needed to know if it was the right color and they refused to tell me. The bumber is already more than if I bought new at dealership so it would only be worth it if it was the same color I need. Only place I have bought parts that doesn’t let you see the parts before you buy not even a picture.

You must be mentally challenged brother. Because you don’t make any sense. You want to change people to tell them the color of a part? I have my own business and I really don’t understand how you are still in business. I could never treat customers the way you do. I was not asking for a discount I was willing to pay full price if it’s the right color part. What part of that do you not understand? Luckily I went to another salvage yard and bought the bumper the color I needed. And guess what? They didn’t charge me to tell/show me the color of it.

If you want to visit a place with a rude staff and even worse OWNER, This is the spot for you. They have no consideration for you or the money you are willing to spend with them (no longer the case for me).

I had a question that needed to be addressed by the OWNER and never had a chance to ask it. He was more interested in listening to himself talk rather than letting me (THE CUSTOMER) say what I needed to say.

Here is the thing, had he given me a chance to speak, I was willing to pay 3x the amount of the asking price due to the part being hard to find (only one in the country). My reason for doing this, I was willing to have a friend pick up the module as I am in another state.

I know this sounds strange, but I am a business owner and HAD (key word) a customer who needed this part. They were willing to wait if I could get it.

Ended up having to send them to the dealer, who could not help as the part has been discontinued. So now this customer has a completely hooked up off-road wrangler that won't move. All because this guy didn't want to help and make more money for not doing anything.

I do not understand how places like this stay in business, any good comments on this place must be written by friends or family members. I am going to make it a point to check back on this. If I see my post drop, I will re-post. People need to be aware of places like this.

Blonde hispanic lady(thinking she white) Very rude. You can tell she don't like her job No experienced what so ever.. they want to charge 20 just to go to the back and view part.. They had it posted as good condition I drove 15min. It look like they used it as a floor mat.

Out of state buyers just don’t even bother. Parts guy wants you to pay through Zelle which isn’t really an issue . It’s more so their crazy shipping prices for items that weight less than 4 pounds . Take your business esle where

DO BUY ANY MOTORS HERE. Bad service, employees always in bad moods and they over charge and are crooks. Our shop had to get 3 motors from these guys because the 2 before were bad. They lie and try their best to get money out of you.

Call from another salvage yard in Houston for a headlight and the lady that answered wanted to charge at least 3 times what it cost to ship a headlight to me. Then when I told he she just hung up. Very bad business attitude.
Say one thing over the phone and another in person. Wasted my time.

I can tell most of the reviews on this company are pretentious. Tell the employees and friends to stop the fake reviews.This was not my first time attempting to buy a part from this person. On the wall it states as follows "you must pay for part before you see it"? Service? The"owner" or what ever he tries to pass up as just looked at his phone screen and said  "$250 you pay now then i show you the part" in the most condescending tone. This scrap yard is an insult to local real salvage yards. The way a person conducts business is a reflection of his or hers inner education and manners. I went to another yard down the strip and the guy was bombarded with customers and calls. He found the TIME to show me the part I was looking for. Here is the difference. He asked $325 for the part. He offered exceptional customer service and yes I payed extra for it. But you the person reading this review this is for you! The guy down the street that charged more...treated a customer with respect! If you the "owner" are reading this..this tip is for your bank account..treat the customer right. Not all customers that walk into your business are trying to piss your time off and price haggle you. Some of us come in needing the part we ask and come with our hard earned money to PAY YOU. Dont be another burned out business owner that has plateaued.

Called in to get additional information about a vague listing. Whoever answered the phone was exceedingly rude, and they didn't know a Saturn from a Subaru - so blamed me about their ignorance.  They demanded I pay $20 before they would answer any questions or send me any photos about the transmission.  When asked if I could look at the part to ensure it was the right one, they said I had to hork up the money for the transmission before I could see it.  Entire thing seems like a scam, and I will be buying parts for my transmission swap project elsewhere.

Edit:
What I was calling about was getting more information about a transmission I'm looking for since their system lists the Subaru WRX STI and Subaru WRX as the same vehicle.  It's also ambiguous if a transmission listed is the WRX STI manual, WRX manual, or WRX CVT.  These three are very easy to tell apart with a couple of pictures of the front of the bell housing and the rear of the transmission, and of the three, the WRX STI manual is the only one that is capable of having 700-800 HP pushed through it.  If they had the transmission, that would have opened up the discussion to also getting the driveshaft, axels, and rear diff.

However, instead of addressing issues brought up by the problematic interaction, the owner shows the quality of their character by using personal attacks.  This is not a business operating in good faith and you should take your business elsewhere.  This review was written as a warning to others to avoid this business like the plague.

My order experience was complicated... I ordered some things knowing they weren't for my model, Debbie caught it and asked what was up, she tried to get me the right stuff.  The shipping was very expensive for some very lightweight but largish items (60% of the price of the merch).  The box arrived with one of the box flaps had slipped out of the tape and was kind of open but luckily nothing fell out.

Asked about a subframe got quoted $600 😂(for a used part) then I asked again to make sure he heard me right. Afterwards I told the guy I can get it brand new for $375. I wanted to make him aware that his price was definitely more then a brand new part‼️ Then he tells me to go buy it because $600 is a good price and hangs up on me smh bad attitude/bad business 👎🏼 called and found one at another junk yard down the street for $275‼️ THIS PLACE WILL DEFINITELY UPCHARGE YOU‼️ MAKE SURE TO CHECK OTHER JUNK YARDS BEFORE CALLING HERE

very rude didn't answer the phone correctly had to ask if it was the right place. guy on the other end was a jerk.  last place i would ever go !  had to give them one star just to post but he didn't deserve that one .

I was trying to purchase ABS pumps for 2012-2014 Honda Fit. They had one listed online for $74. The person on the phone refused to sell the product and hung up on me TWICE. Extremely rude.

I needed many of these parts for exporting. When the person asked me how much I was paying for them I said I average $85 but can pay a little more. Which, is $11 MORE than what they were asking.

So far I've purchased 22 of these ABS pumps from yards around the country and no single yard I've spoken to has been this rude.
It's a shame because I spend hundreds of thousands of dollars on parts every year and this place WILL NOT be on my go-to list.

Get your act together and learn how treat customers. You never know who you're talking to.

if i could put 0 stars trust me i would! WORST EXPERIENCE EVER!!

This owner is so rude. I've never been, thank goodness. Just reading your responses would keep ANYONE in their right mind away from here. It costs nothing to be kind and professional. Too many choices out there for this kind of treatment. Very unkind. You won't be getting my business.

I just called this place to get price and information on a part. The gentleman (if you can call him that) who answered the phone was very rude and impatient. I asked whether the damage to the car where this part was coming from was on the front or on the rear. He responded angrily: "HOW AM I SUPPOSED TO KNOW? I DON'T KNOW". And then he went on rambling about how ..."if it's a good part it's a good part, if it's a bad part then it's a bad part. You want it come get it. We take Visa and Mastercard only, direct deposit if you are not local...". No Thanks. I'll pay a little more and take my business elsewhere.

Lady was rude on the phone & when we got there said we couldn’t look at any parts until we buy first.. not gonna buy something I haven’t even looked at. If I could I would give no stars. I went right next door to all economy used foreign parts & they were nice & let us look around & got the parts I needed👍

I drove 3 hours to get a transmission they said they had and they tell me they have about fifty of them to choose from so I think great, wrong! I get home and its the wrong transmission so i drive 3 hours back to them where they give me the right one and finally get back to the house finish installing it and it reverses fine but no forward gears and i call him and he tells me that its a electrical issue with the car when its evident it is a bad transmission but he tells me its my problem that i brought the transmission as is! Now Im out $650 and looking for another transmission! Never trust them! There is no warranty! They will lie to your face!

Worst customer service I have experienced .  The "boss/owner" was very rude impossible to talk to.  All the other positive reviews on here are by the own employees and family members   Do yourself a favor buy your parts else where

OMG...horrible people! They were really nice the day we were there, my Mother and myself looking for a headlight for my Mazda 6. We took the time to look for one and the website showed one in stock, however apparantly that one was not there for $350.00 when we got there. They found another one for $175.00 and said it was good, just needed some cleaning and a couple brackets. Got it into the body shop and the people there said the light was not a good light, was missing several parts and could not even use it. We had it looked at by a reputable salvage yard and they said it was worth $25.00 at the most. I am a single working mother and was desperately looking for a part to fix my car to use to get to work. The guy I talked to when I called said no returns and I was out of luck. We are contacting a attorney to see if there is anything we can do. This is horrible, can't believe there are people out there like this. Don't trust them unless you know more about car parts then we did. Ruthless People!!!
